title: cynanchica lutea
intro: Cynanchica lutea, commonly known as Yellow Milkweed, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cynanchica lutea include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and antidiabetic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
